Nice App to Plan Your Day. Structured is a nice app to plan your day, but some things should be better. 

1. If you don’t want your users to get lost in 3-dotted ‘More’ menus, adjusting time of events should be more intuitive and easier. 

2. The calendar of Structured needs more features like weekly and monthly views and/or on-calendar editing etc. to copy or edit tasks easily. I can only copy-paste the tasks from one day to another at the moment. However, copying tasks from one week or month to another or editing the tasks is an ideal experience. 

3. Deleting tasks can be made easier like dragging and dropping them to a trash can or something. 

4. Some menu items and their shortcuts like Undo and thus Redo don’t seem to work properly on macOS version. For example, if you clear a day, but change your mind later, good luck with that. There is no undo for that. Actually, all together the menu may need a fix.

5. More icons and style functionality can make it look better. 

6. Synchronization with other popular to-do lists like Things, etc. for Pro users can make Structured more flexible and usable with them. 

Even before these, I like the app and recommend it to others.
